Name: Cabin Passenger Count Load Factor %
Description: Boarded passengers / available cabin seats; ratio of sums at flight-cabin grain.

Name: Cabin Passenger Revenue
Description: Passenger revenue at flight-cabin grain in source units.

Name: Service Case Count
Description: Count of service cases, not unique passengers.

Name: First Contact Resolution %
Description: Share of valid binary first-contact-resolution flags equal to 1.
SQL: 100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_SERVICE_CASE.first_contact_resolved_flag=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_SERVICE_CASE.first_contact_resolved_flag IN (0,1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)
Expression: 100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_SERVICE_CASE.first_contact_resolved_flag=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_SERVICE_CASE.first_contact_resolved_flag IN (0,1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)
Expanded SQL: 100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_SERVICE_CASE.first_contact_resolved_flag=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_SERVICE_CASE.first_contact_resolved_flag IN (0,1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)

Name: Average Service Resolution Days
Description: Mean recorded non-null resolution days; open cases may have no recorded resolution.

Name: Average Service CSAT
Description: Mean non-null service-case satisfaction score; preserve recorded score scale.

Name: Baggage Claim Count
Description: Claim records, not number of bags or unique passengers.

Name: Baggage Compensation
Description: Recorded baggage compensation in source monetary units.

Name: Baggage Average Resolution Days
Description: Mean non-null recorded days to resolve a baggage claim.

Name: Maintenance Event Cost
Description: Total recorded cost at maintenance-event grain.

Name: Maintenance Downtime Hours
Description: Recorded event downtime hours. Overlapping events can overlap elapsed aircraft downtime; do not call this distinct aircraft out-of-service duration.

Name: Crew Overtime Hours
Description: Assignment overtime minutes converted to hours; not unique flight duration.

Name: Crew Assignment Pay
Description: Recorded pay at crew-assignment grain; do not add to route crew cost without reconciliation.

Name: Card Application Approval %
Description: Approved application records divided by all application records; not approval among decided-only applications.

Name: Cardholder Spend
Description: Recorded account-month card spend; not airline revenue.

Name: Loyalty Miles Earned
Description: Monthly loyalty miles earned; additive flow, unlike miles_balance_end.

Name: Loyalty Miles Redeemed
Description: Monthly loyalty miles redeemed; additive flow.

Name: Survey Response Count
Description: Survey records; include valid NPS denominator separately when computing NPS.

Name: Average Airport Weather Severity
Description: Mean recorded severity at airport-day grain; not flight-weighted and not a causal estimate.

Name: Ancillary Transaction Count
Description: Ancillary sale records, not passengers or total item quantity.
